summary: One focused behavior: ending-variant branching (2+ outcomes from a single decision), one-shot trigger, credits flag, and restart, with the full fresh-save headless ending scenario as final proof owner. Two concrete subsystems changed. The criterion AC-end-variants is carried verbatim from parent WI-05c. Dependencies on WI-05b (decision-point context) and WI-05cb (autosave milestones for integration save-reload) are correct and non-circular. The one-shot/credits/restart elements are inseparable parts of the ending behavior, not independently shippable features. The verification is a focused ending scenario, not a whole-game delivery check. Handoff names exact files and request sections sufficient for a fresh implementer.
